findings.text: The company has the status 'liquidation' and was wound up on 20 March 2026 under a creditors voluntary liquidation.
Accounts are overdue, with the next filing due on 30 November 2025 and the last accounts made up to 29 February 2024.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company.
One person with significant control, PERSON 301, holds between 75 and 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Since 24 October 2025, there was one officer appointment and one resignation, involving PERSON 292 and PERSON 293 on 7 November 2025.
The current director, PERSON 292, has two other appointments in dissolved companies.
The registered office address was changed on 1 April 2026.

headline.text: ACME {company_number} {facts} LTD is in liquidation following a creditors voluntary liquidation, with overdue accounts and outstanding charges.
